raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was delivered twice, at 02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-19, and the second delivery repeated 316 rows. The duplicate rows appear identical, and silver_transactions has no dedup on txn_id, so every downstream gold table double-counts those rows. Fix: keep the latest-ingested row per txn_id, then filter to POSTED. The gold tables are rebuilt from silver, so no other step needs changing.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
